target.title: fix(voice-call): handle spawn error on tailscale stop cleanup
target.body:
## Summary

Add error handler on the tailscale stop spawn in `stopTailscaleTunnel`. Without it, a missing binary causes an unhandled error event (crash) AND the promise hangs forever.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

**Behavior addressed**: `spawn("tailscale", ...)` in `stopTailscaleTunnel` without `proc.on("error", ...)`. If tailscale is missing, the async error event is both unhandled (crash) and the promise never resolves (neither `close` nor `error` fires).

**Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, OpenClaw main

**Exact steps run after this patch**:
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/voice-call/src/tunnel.test.ts
```

**Evidence after fix**:
```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

New test "handles spawn errors on tailscale stop cleanup without crashing": starts a tunnel, calls stop, emits error on the stop spawn via FakeChildProcess.fail(), and verifies the stop promise still resolves.

**Before-fix evidence**: Same test on main — FakeChildProcess emits error → Node throws unhandled error → test runner crashes. Also: promise hangs forever (neither close nor error handler exists).

**Observed result after fix**: Error handler cleans up timeout and resolves. Same pattern already used for ngrok spawns at lines 154 and 200 in the same file.

**What was not tested**: Live tailscale binary missing (requires OS-level removal).

## Risk

Low. One-line handler addition. Follows the existing pattern in the same file.
